See all, evade all. Instinctively avoid attacks, detect concealed dangers, and identify hidden entities. Nothing escapes your watchful gaze.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Instinctual Avoidance: 20% Chance to auto-dodge melee attacks. 100% chance to auto-dodge thrown projectiles (arrows, kunai, etc)
Passive: [Passive - In Slot in this mode] Danger Detection: Like Danger Sense
Active
[Active] Presence Detection: Upon holding down, boosts the user’s Presence Sense Level by 1 and Presence Sense Distance by 20 blocks. If activated while sneaking down, cycle through the available Presence Sense mode:
All: Like any Presence Sense ability - Highlights all mobs in sensing radius in blue, even invisible ones or ones under the effect of concealing abilities.
Monsters: Highlights any monsters in sensing radius in certain colors: [Neutral: Yellow, Enemy: Red]
Trap: Highlights any trap blocks in halved sensing radius in red. [Trap blocks: Lava, Pointed Dripstone, Tripwire, Sculk Sensor, Sculk Shrieker, Cobweb, Powder Snow, Trapped Chest, TNT, TNT Minecart, End Crystal].
Treasure: Available with Mastery, highlights any treasure blocks in halved sensing radius in gold. [Treasure blocks: Chest, Barrel, Vault, Dragon Egg, Ancient Debris and Magic Ore, Charybdis Core].

"You seek to build a world of ideals. Be warned as not everyone shares the same ideals. Raze anything in your path with a clap of lightning.")

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Teravolt:
Increases the damage of Lighting-based attacks by 2x. Stacks with Lightning Manipulation and Lightning Domination.
Active
[Active, Press] Bolt Strike:
On activation, the user summons a massive bolt of lightning at the targeted location, dealing 50 electricity and 50 physical damage to those unfortunate enough to be caught in its wake. Cooldown of 10 seconds, reducing to 5 on mastery.
Active: [Active, Held] Fusion Bolt:
The user charges up lightning, letting it surround them as they charge towards their enemy. The user then hits their target with all the charged lightning. dealing both 30 Physical and 30 Electric Damage. This costs 500 Magicules.
If you have Unique Skill [Reshiram] in slot, it summons flames around your target as well as you hit them, dealing 40 Flame Damage, if this happens, the cost is increased to 700 Magicules.
20 second cooldown for this mode.
Active: [Active, Held] Draconic Breath:
Costs 240 MP per second while this is held down. The user lets out a draconic breath of purple flames from their mouth, blasting your enemies with it. Grants enemies the Paralysis effect and deals 60 magic damage on contact. 10 Second CD
Active: [Active, Press] Thunderbolt:
Costs 250 MP. The user summons lightning where they are looking, dealing 60 Electricity damage.

Assess the soul of your opponents to gain insight into their overall strength.

Active
[Active - Press] - When activated, creates a screen overlay that displays information about the currently looked at block or mob in 5 blocks radius (10 with Mastery). Analysis Level 1 - Displays Name, HP, MP, AP, Armor Points, etc. With Mastery - Analysis Level 2, displays the skills of the target Only Players (except for skills flagged as mastered). If a target has greater than 1.5X (2X with Mastery) the player's EP, then only its base stats are shown (Name, HP, SHP, Armor).
Shift + Activate to change between Block Only Analysis, Entity Only Analysis or Both.

GreatSage compatibility: Tap the Analytical Appraisal key (V by default) to toggle the interface, or hold it to appraise. Tensura manual dodging is paused while the appraisal interface is open. After closing it and releasing the key, press the dodge key again to dodge normally.

Deal damage from afar while using different bullets to get past resistances and ensure a quick kill.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle + In Slot] Spatial Manipulation: x2 Spatial Damage & Warp Shot [In Slot while in this Mode]
When active, non-magic projectiles (Arrows, Spear, Kunai, Sniper Bullet, Web Bullet, Potions, Thrown Item (from Thrower), Egg, Ender Pearl, Firework Rocket, Snowball, Trident) will automatically warp to the back of the looked-at target's head and shot at the speed of the original speed multiplied by the warp shot level. Sneak to not warp shot while shooting. Cost 50 MP each warp.
When activated, grant the user warp shot level of 0.5. Press again to deactivate. (Stackable)
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] - Magic Sense: Same as normal. Treated as Mastered.
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] - Predictive Calculation: 10% Chance to auto-dodge an attack. 50% Chance to ignore dodge on enemies. Nullification is treated as resistance and resistance is bypassed. Magic Jamming's damage mitigation is ignored.
Active
[Active - Press] Create Weapon: If used when not looking at a mob, creates a Walther P99 Pistol in the player's empty hand [Sneak Right-clicking to change Bullet Mode: Magic and Physical. Physical Bullet consumes 100 AP and deals 30 Physical Damage - 1s (0s with mastery) cooldown, Magic Bullet consumes 100 MP and deals 100 (200 with Mastery) Magic Damage - 3s (0s with mastery) cooldown. If Sniper is actively in a slot and is mastered, the bullets will teleport behind a looked at enemy when fired instead]. If activated while looking at an entity or already having a pistol in 1 hand, throws a grenade at the mob which explodes and deals damage in a 5x5 block radius - 3s cooldown (1s with mastery).
Magic Bullet will apply severance if Warp Shot is active

Cut back on the cookies.

Active
[Active] Giantification: When activated, increases player height by 3 blocks and grants +6 Attack Damage (Speed, Jump Strength and Attack/Mining reach increases according to size change).
When mastered, gain the ability to choose size modification among [-1, 0, 1, 2, 3 blocks] increase while still keep the strength effect. Sneak-activate to turn off.

Wield the power to cut through any who stand in your path, whether by coating your strikes or launching slashing projectiles that sever all in their path.

Active
[Active - Press] - Coating: Costs 1,000 MP, adds a 50 (200 if mastered) damage boost, as well as a severance effect to the player's attacks for 60 seconds.
Resist Bypass: Bypasses Resistances and treats Nullifications as Resistances while coat is active.
Active: [Active - Press] - Projectile: Costs 20,000 MP, launches an invisible projectile that deals 50 (300 with Mastery) Damage and has a severance effect. Projectile is 5 blocks(10 with mastery). 3s Cooldown

Clay:D

Passive
[Sub-Skill] Cold Clay - The user will learn Flame Attack Resistance when Malleable is acquired.
[Passive, Toggle] Memory Material - All resistances are learned 5x faster, and so are earth type magics/abilities. They are also mastered 5x faster.
Active
[Active, Press] Alchemy - Cycle through 13 different modes; Physical, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Piercing, Earth, Water, Light, Dark, Holy, Poison, Corrosion, and Wind. Similar to Magic Aura, change any damage dealt from the player to this damage type. Upon mastery, becomes a toggle. 10 second cooldown.
Active: [Active, Held] Harden - While holding this skill, disable flight, movement, the ability to attack, and spatial moves, and give yourself regeneration 5 and resistance 2, alongside 10 armor points. After releasing, put the skill on cooldown for 120 seconds (60 seconds on mastery) and give weakness 2 and slowness 2 for 30 seconds.
Active: [Active, Press] Vessel - Summon a clay golem with 40 max health, with no AI, allowing it to be possessed by anyone who's able to. If another player possesses it, they become a temporary subordinate until they leave the body/die. Maximum of 2 may exist. On mastery, increases the max health of the Vessel to 200.

Boosts Space skills by a decent amount and manipulate space to empower your ranged attacks.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Increases Spatial Damage by 1.5x. Doesn't stack with Spatial Domination.
Passive: [Passive - In Slot] - Warp Shot: (Requires Learning) - When active, non-magic projectiles (Arrows, Spear, Kunai, Sniper Bullet, Web Bullet, Potions, Thrown Item (from Thrower), Egg, Ender Pearl, Firework Rocket, Snowball, Trident) will automatically warp to the back of the looked-at target's head and shot at the speed of the original speed multiplied by the warp shot level. Sneak to not warp shot while shooting. Cost 50 MP each warp.
When activated, grant the user warp shot level of 0.5. Press again to deactivate.

Channel the powers of space to weaken and damage all nearby entities.

Passive
On Obtainment - Grants access to the intermediate level of Space Spirit Magic
Active
[Active - Hold] - At the cost of 30 MP per 20 ticks held down and 50% speed, deal 2 space damage and apply weakness for all mobs within a 10x10 radius.

3 Modes.
Blink: Teleports the player to where their cursor is looking. Costs 10MP per block distance. - Max: 30 Blocks (50 Blocks if mastered).
Coordinates: Prompts the player to enter coordinates (X, Y, Z) and teleports them there after 100 ticks. Becomes instant with Mastery. (Costs 10 per block distance)
Portal: Same as Coordinates, but opens a portal instead of teleporting that other entities can also pass through and lasts for 20 Seconds. (Costs 50 per block distance)

Doesn't stack with Spatial Manipulation
Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Increases Spatial Damage by 3x. Mastery grants Spatial resistance/nullification degrade if the user has 800k ep
Passive: [Passive - In Slot] Warp Shot: When active, non-magic projectiles (Arrows, Spear, Kunai, Sniper Bullet, Web Bullet, Potions, Thrown Item (from Thrower), Egg, Ender Pearl, Firework Rocket, Snowball, Trident) will automatically warp to the back of the looked-at target's head and shot at the speed of the original speed multiplied by the warp shot level. Sneak to not warp shot while shooting. Cost 50 MP each warp.
When activated, grant the user warp shot level of 1. Press again to deactivate. (Doesn't stack with Manipulation).
Active
[Active - Hold] Dimension Ray (Requires Learning) - Costs 5,000 MP each second. Spawn a ray ranging 30 blocks that deals 50 (100 with mastery) damage per second to anything hit. Maximum held time is 3s followed by 10s cooldown (7s with Mastery).
Active: [Active] Dimension Storm (Requires Learning Dimension Ray) Costs 50,000 MP, deals 50 (100 with mastery) Damages all mobs within a 10x10 radius of where the player looks (20 block range) - 20s Cooldown (10s with mastery).
Active: [Hold] Fault Field (Requires Learning) While held, (costs 2000 MP per 20 Ticks), makes the user immune to all non-ultimate skill attacks that don't deal spatial damage or mental/spiritual damage (MP Cost = Damage Taken * 50).
Active: [Active] Spatial Cleanse (Requires Learning) - Remove severance with a cost of 100 mp per Severance value. 3 second cooldown. Shift activate to use on others.

50 MP per second for each subordinate. User's speed is reduced to 5% while active (10% with mastery). All mobs within a 10x10 radius of the user and user's subordinates are affected. If mob's EP is =<75% of the user's EP, it does nothing. Otherwise, give 1 Fear level for each 20% difference in EP. With mastery, scroll while holding down the skill button to change the percentage of EP used for calculation. Additionally grants a Strength 4 effect (Strength 8 with mastery) to user's subordinates for 1 minute.
